charts.title: TOI-4602 b: orbits around TOI-4602
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-4602's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-4602 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Di Maio et al. 2026 (2026A&A...709A.270D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname DI_MAIO_ET_AL_2026): P 3.9812999 d
